__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This guard is surely a trained and skilled fighter.  He is fully armed and
armored, and he uses his equipment with a practiced precision.  Luckily for
you, this guard will only use his deadly skills for the good of the citizens of
Ofcol.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Ofcol cityguard is standing here, making sure there is no trouble.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Diana is a beautiful, powerfully built woman.  She wears platinum armor for
three reasons.  The first is to show she is strong enough to withstand the
weight.  The second is to show her rank of office.  The third is that platinum
is the hardest metal she can find.  She is willing to defend Ofcol to her
death.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Diana, the Marshall of Ofcol, stands here proudly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle marshall diana

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Derrick is a very big man.  He has acquired this station, not by brains or
charm, but by brute strength.  He had fought in three orc wars and is a
descendent of a surviving cityguard of old Thalos.  He believes that everything
has to be hard won to be kept, and that laxity is for the weak.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Derrick, Captain of the Guard, is here disciplining his guards.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle derrick captain guard cityguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Jacklyn is pale and wiry, but then, so are most other witches.  The fact that
Jacklyn is a mage and a warrior makes her the perfect captain of the citadel
guards.  Jacklyn is very beautiful, but whether it is due to her pale softness
or her magic, no one has ever found out.  She isn't very strong physically, but
she need not be.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Jacklyn, Captain of the Citadel Guard, is here raising morale.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jacklyn captain guard cityguard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Jim is big and brawny, just like what you'd expect of a blacksmith.  He is
smiling a very big smile, as he looks at your coins.  You wonder if he likes
the metals or the value of the coins.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Jim the Blacksmith is here, selling his latest works of metal.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jim blacksmith

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Sam is a middle-aged workman.  He looks tired, but never too tired to get that
last sale from you.  He grins at you slightly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Sam is here, selling his leather works.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sam

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Madam Tracy is a bit old, but not to the point of senility.  Besides, she knows
the hard ways of this world and is ready for it.  She spends her time at the
shop, trading little things (for a wee bit of profit).
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Madam Tracy is here, selling and buying little treasures.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle madam tracy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Marty is a big man.  He used to hunt the animals he sells, but now he lets his
son, Jim, raise and slaughter the animals for him.  Marty still knows how to
kill, though.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Marty the meat store owner is here, selling you his choice meats.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle marty

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Elizabeth is a very happy woman.  She can't believe the nice weather here in
Ofcol, and the great vegetables this land produces is unbelievable to her too.
Farmer Elizabeth smiles at you nicely, but you bet she is doing that just to
get a good price off of you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Farmer Elizabeth is here, selling the latest crop.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elizabeth farmer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Granny Jenkins is a feeble woman, but she knows her brew.  She might be very
old, but she is still in charge of the still.  She cackles lightly at herself
every time she tastes her whiskey, which is quite often!
Granny Jenkins cackles again.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Granny Jenkins is here, running the still.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle granny jenkins

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Jack is the son of Marty, and you can see the family resemblance (especially in
their shared affinity for slaughtering animals.)  Jack leers at you as you
enter.  "Came by to watch, eh?", he asks.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Jack is here slaughtering away at the animals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle jack

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Farmer Sara is all covered with bits of straw and grime, but underneath all
that, she doesn't look that bad.  She smiles at you demurely, and goes back to
her work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Farmer Sara is here, milking the cows.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle sarah farmer

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The hen has yellow feathers and small wings.  It looks like a chicken, if
you've ever seen one.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hen is here, squawking at your intrusion.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chicken hen

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The cow is here happily grazing.  It moos at you and goes back to grazing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cow is here, munching on grass.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The cow is just standing here.  She moos at you and otherwise ignores you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A cow is here, waiting to be milked.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cow

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The horse whinnies at you, then runs around you a few times, then just goes
back to grazing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A young horse is here, grazing.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle horse young

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The pig looks dirty.  It snorts and sniffs at you, then goes back to its slop.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A pig is playing here, getting itself and you dirty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pig

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The citizen smiles at you.  He is having a great day, and he wishes the same
for you.  He looks at you strangely, though, wondering why you are so armed and
armored.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A citizen is here, smiling at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen man

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The citizen smiles at you.  She is having a great day, and she wishes the same
for you.  She looks at you strangely, though, wondering why you are so armed
and armored.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A citizen is here, smiling at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle citizen woman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The little boy looks up at you and says, 'Hi.  Can I have a piece of candy?'
He then smiles and runs away, remembering his game.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A boy is here, playing tag and other kids' games.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle child boy

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The little girl looks up at you and says, 'Hi.  Can I have a pretty little
coin?'  She then smiles and runs away, remembering her game.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A girl is here, playing jump jacks and other kids' games.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle child girl

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The maid startles at your presence.  'You are ruining my floors!  Wait till
Master and Mistress come back.  You will get me in trouble!  Shoo!', she says.
She hits you with her broom.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A maid is here, cleaning the house and preparing the next meal.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle maid woman

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
Nyles is a hefty guy, who looks like he's waiting for the next bar fight to
join in.  He keeps an eye on you and his glasses, making sure you don't steal
any.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: Nyles the Bartender is here, ready to serve you up a good brew.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle nyles

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This guard is surely a trained and skilled fighter.  He is fully armed and
armored, and he uses his equipment with a practiced precision.  Luckily for
you, this guard will only use his deadly skills for the good of the citizens of
Ofcol.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Ofcol cityguard is posted here to guard the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cityguard guard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
After years of traveling around the world, this bard has decided to stay in the
peaceful city of Ofcol, and to sing of its unmatched glories.  He smiles at
you, hinting toward a tip from you in ever a subtle way.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A bard is here, singing of the glories of Ofcol.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle bard

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The servant smiles good-naturedly at you, then goes on his duties.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A servant is here, carrying the duties of the Keeper of the Golden Citadel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle servant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: This young man smiles at you, but is too busy to chat.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A squire is here, scurrying from duty to duty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle squire

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The page smiles for you, asking if he can do you a favor too.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A page is here, sending a message to his knight.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle page

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Priestess of Ofcol is an old woman, perfectly at peace with herself and
with the world.  She devotes all her time to help teach you the ways of her
god, Bahamut.  The dragon symbol around her neck looks almost alive.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
The Priestess of Ofcol is here, blessing you
with her beatific smile.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle priestess

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He smiles at you, with the enthusiasm of a little kid.  "What're you doing just
STANDING here, young man?  Go help that other squire there!", he yells.  He
turns to you and with a consipatory tone, whispers, "Kids!"
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
Jerrold, the chaplain of this Citadel, is here
directing the activities of the people around here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle chaplain jerrold

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This person looks almost like a dragon itself.  His golden scales gleam with
power.  He smiles at you with a vicious grin.  You're happy that he doesn't
look upset at your presence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A knight wearing the scales of a dragon stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragonlord lord dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This dragon's head is taller than you.  He is annoyed at your disturbance, but
realizing that you're no danger to him, he ignores you.  He waves to one of
his attendants to escort you away.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
An old dragon shimmering with the colors of this
cavern peers at you sleepily.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragon gold

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This elder servant to the Gold Dragon is very loyal to him, willing to risk
his life for his liege.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A person robed in gold is attending to the Keeper of the Citadel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle attendant

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This person looks like a dragon itself.  His golden scales gleam with power.
He smiles at you, showing very sharp teeth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr:
A person dressed in the scales of a gold dragon
stands here, guarding the Golden Citadel.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dragonknight knight dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
This guard is surely a trained and skilled fighter.  He is fully armed and
armored, and he uses his equipment with a practiced precision.  Luckily for
you, this guard will only use his deadly skills for the good of the citizens of
Ofcol.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An Ofcol cityguard is posted here to guard the gate.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle cityguard guard
